_about: Status effects. Definitions follow the FORSAKEN wiki 'Status Effects' page (read 2026-10-01) unless 'source' says otherwise. stacking: max = keep higher level, refresh longer duration; add = add levels and refresh duration; add_keep = add levels, keep the running timer (Bleeding); replace = overwrite.

statuses.name: Slowness
statuses.description: -10% movement speed per level; each level cancels one Speed level.

statuses.name: Speed
statuses.description: +10% movement speed per level.

statuses.name: Resistance
statuses.description: -20% damage taken per level; V or higher blocks all damage; negates Burning.

statuses.name: Vulnerable
statuses.description: +20% damage taken per level; each level cancels one Resistance level.

statuses.name: Weakness
statuses.description: -10% damage dealt per level.

statuses.name: Strength
statuses.description: +20% damage dealt per level.

statuses.name: Helpless
statuses.description: Cannot use abilities.

statuses.name: Stunned
statuses.description: Cannot move or use abilities; cancels windups and channels. Managed by the stun system.

statuses.name: Bleeding
statuses.description: 2 damage per second per level except the final second; cannot take HP below 10.

statuses.name: Burning
statuses.description: 1.9/2.5/3.3/4.3/6.2 damage per second; can kill; nullified by Resistance.

statuses.name: Poisoned
statuses.description: Damage over time that cannot kill (stops at 1 HP).

statuses.name: Corrupted
statuses.description: 1.9 damage/s at I, about +35% per level up to 6.2 at V; cannot kill.

statuses.name: Glitched
statuses.description: Scrambles the health and stamina display. Makes Entanglement pull 50% harder and lets 1x1x1x1's zombies kill.

statuses.name: Blindness
statuses.description: 20% screen blur per level, max III.

statuses.name: Hallucination
statuses.description: Noli's debuff, 20 s. Level n gives n fakes (wrong timer, fake heals); III always spawns a hostile Noli mirage whose hits are fake. Visible to Noli as an aura.

statuses.name: Hemorrhage
statuses.description: Lowers maximum HP over time (not current HP directly); max HP returns gradually after it ends. Hemorrhaged survivors drop Blood Orbs.

statuses.name: Subspaced
statuses.description: Pink tint and camera jerks; cancels the victim's active aura reads; cannot be reapplied while active.

statuses.name: Oblivious
statuses.description: Cannot hear the killer's terror radius.

statuses.name: Creatures
statuses.description: Takes 25% more damage; trails bats.

statuses.name: Exhausted
statuses.description: -10% stamina regen and +10% stamina drain per level.

statuses.name: Marked
statuses.description: Red aura to the killer that bypasses Undetectable; removed if Undetectable is gained.

statuses.name: Invisibility
statuses.description: Each level adds 25% transparency and mutes footsteps (rendered with vanilla Invisibility from level III).

statuses.name: Undetectable
statuses.description: Ignored by aura reads, minions and chase music.

statuses.name: Purified
statuses.description: The next hit is reduced by 20% per 20 HP missing (max 80%).

statuses.name: Resonance
statuses.description: Jane Doe's mark on the killer, 30 s: Hatchet stuns 2.5/3.5/4.5 s.

statuses.name: Slateskin
statuses.description: +40 overheal per level, -45% speed; immune to Bleeding, Burning, Poisoned, Corrupted, Regeneration, Speed, Hemorrhage and Weakness.

statuses.name: Regeneration
statuses.description: Heal over time (pizza, chicken, battery); cancelled by real damage above a threshold.

statuses.name: Invincible
statuses.description: Immune to offensive abilities except Builderman's Sentry and Taph's Subspace Tripmine.

statuses.name: Stun Immunity
statuses.description: Cannot be stunned.

statuses.name: Flagged
statuses.description: Daemon (original killer): shown on Daemon's HUD within 40 blocks; Daemon moves 5% faster toward the nearest Flagged survivor.
